# Getting started

Acme turns a folder of Markdown into a static site.

## Install

Install the CLI with npm:

```sh
npm install --save-dev acme-cli
```

Acme needs Node.js 22 or later.

## Your first build

Run `npx acme build` in the folder with your pages. The site is written to `out/`, one HTML file per page.
